scope: Local predeclaration before this dense sweep, informed by earlier coarse results; not an independently registered confirmatory study.
timing_protocol: Unchanged from the coarse runtime audit: dynamic initial/bounds inputs, separate lower+compile and warmup, all configurations prepared before seeded shuffled serial rounds, whole-output synchronization, host validation outside timing.

matching.eligibility: Compatible problem, dtype, order, interval, feedback, first step and budget; completed finite numerical measurements and stable finite positive timings.
matching.selection: Export every eligible pair, without using accuracy to select pairs; no interpolation or extrapolation.
matching.coverage_goal: At least one eligible pair for each case in each precision. Report unmet coverage rather than tuning the grid after observing outcomes.

reported_outcomes: Expected and collected unique configurations and samples
Completion, failure flags, and elementwise repeatability
Pair count and coverage by case and precision
failure_policy: Retain exhausted and other incomplete solves with timings but no full-span accuracy. Do not increase budget to eliminate failures. Strict completion --check may fail without invalidating measured failure evidence.
stopping_rule: One full sweep per precision, serially, with no concurrent tests or numerical benchmarks. No post-hoc tolerance or matching-threshold adjustment. Infrastructure failures are reported separately and any retry must be disclosed.
interpretation: Pairs can reuse configurations and are not independent trials. Ratios concern each mesh's maximum error and the common endpoint separately, not a dense-output/global-error bound or universal efficiency ranking.
